description:
Create a 'Hip Roof' plan view for an L-shaped building in LibreCAD.

1. DRAWING SETUP:
   - Create 3 layers: 'WALLS' (White/Color 7), 'ROOF_LINES' (Cyan/Color 4), and 'NOTES' (Yellow/Color 2).

2. WALL OUTLINE (on layer 'WALLS'):
   - Draw an L-shaped closed polygon with these coordinates (in order): (0,0) -> (12,0) -> (12,6) -> (6,6) -> (6,10) -> (0,10) -> (0,0).

3. ROOF GEOMETRY (on layer 'ROOF_LINES'):
   - Construct a hip roof plan assuming equal slopes (hips/valleys are at 45 degrees in plan).
   - Draw the hip lines from the 5 outer corners inward.
   - Draw the valley line from the inner corner (6,6) inward.
   - Draw the connecting ridge lines.
   - Hint: For this 6m-wide L-shape, the ridges and valley will intersect at coordinate (3,3).

4. ANNOTATIONS (on layer 'NOTES'):
   - Add text 'VALLEY' near the valley line.
   - Add text 'RIDGE' near one of the ridge lines.

5. SAVE:
   - Save the drawing to '/home/ga/Documents/LibreCAD/hip_roof_plan.dxf'.
